words.input: DECLARE v_name VARCHAR2(100):='Pomo'; BEGIN DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(v_name); END;
words.annotation: DECLARE BEGIN END：匿名ブロック（/はSQL*Plus・SQLcl等の実行区切り。API送信時は通常付けない）

words.input: BEGIN IF 2>1 THEN DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('yes'); ELSIF 2=1 THEN NULL; ELSE NULL; END IF; END;
BEGIN FOR i IN 1..3 LOOP CONTINUE WHEN i=2; DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(i); END LOOP; END;
BEGIN UPDATE users SET name='New' WHERE id=1; DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(SQL%ROWCOUNT); END;
words.annotation: UPDATE / SQL%ROWCOUNT：更新件数（直前の対応SQLの件数。WHEREなしは全行）

words.input: BEGIN FOR r IN (SELECT id,name FROM users ORDER BY id) LOOP DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(r.name); END LOOP; END;
words.annotation: カーソルFORループ：行を順に処理（OPEN・FETCH・CLOSEを自動管理）

words.input: DECLARE TYPE user_rec IS RECORD(id NUMBER,name VARCHAR2(100)); r user_rec; BEGIN r.id:=1; r.name:='Pomo'; END;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE double_value(p_in IN NUMBER,p_out OUT NUMBER) AS BEGIN p_out:=p_in*2; END;
words.annotation: PROCEDURE / IN OUT：手続きを定義（スキーマへの定義権限が必要）

words.input: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_one(p_n IN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER AS BEGIN RETURN p_n+1; END;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY math_api AS FUNCTION twice(n NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS BEGIN RETURN n*2; END; END;
words.annotation: PACKAGE / PACKAGE BODY：宣言と実装を分離（呼出はmath_api.twice(2)等）

words.input: DECLARE v_name VARCHAR2(100); BEGIN EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT name FROM users WHERE id=:id' INTO v_name USING 1; END;
words.annotation: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE / USING：パラメーター付き動的SQL（値をバインド。識別子の未検証連結を避ける）

words.input: BEGIN SAVEPOINT before_change; UPDATE users SET name='New' WHERE id=1; ROLLBACK TO before_change; END;
words.annotation: COMMIT / ROLLBACK / SAVEPOINT：確定・取消・復帰地点（例は更新を戻す。DDLは暗黙COMMITが生じるため別扱い）

words.input: DECLARE v_id users.id%TYPE; BEGIN SELECT id INTO v_id FROM users WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE; END;
words.annotation: SELECT FOR UPDATE：行をロック（ブロック終了だけでは取引終了しない。COMMIT/ROLLBACKまで保持）
